environment.measurement_caveat: All Ruflo trees are Docker bind mounts over Docker Desktop's macOS virtiofs. Cold first-touch of the 50,012-file install tree costs seconds to tens of seconds and is the dominant error term; a control run of the dependency-free Tailered repo showed 10-75x run-to-run variance on the same command. Steady-state (warm) figures are the comparable ones; cold figures are reported separately and are an upper bound, not a native-filesystem number.

cli_latency.interpretation: pass2 ran before pass3 and paid the cold first-touch of the bind-mounted install, so its numbers are HIGHER than pass3 despite having no network - the difference is host page cache, not network. pass3 (warm) is the honest steady-state: --version p50 22.1 ms (a hardcoded fast path in bin/ruflo.js that never loads the CLI), --help p50 311.0 ms, status p50 219.3 ms. Cold first invocation observed up to 17,903 ms (--help) and 18,680 ms; ruflo's own source comments a 'blocking 60+ s' cold path.

statusline_root_cause.mechanism: execSync of `<node> <cli> hooks statusline --json` over a candidate list ending in `npx --prefer-offline @claude-flow/cli`, each with `timeout: 8000`. When no candidate resolves, every render burns the full 8 s timeout before falling back to cache.
statusline_root_cause.network_dependence: none - 8,271.0 ms p50 with --network none, 8,270.6 ms p50 with network
statusline_root_cause.stale_version_symptom: renders 'RuFlo V3.32.8' on the slow path (hardcoded `let ver = "3.32.8"` at line 839) vs the correct 'V3.37.0' on the fast path
